content_sections.heading: About NIT Srinagar
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Srinagar is in Hazratbal, Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir (190006). It is an autonomous Institute of National Importance under the aegis of the Ministry of Education, Government of India, and one of the 31 NITs set up by the Government of India. The institute runs undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes in Engineering/Technology, Sciences and allied areas.

content_sections.heading: NIT Srinagar Temporary Teaching Staff Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. B.E. / B. Tech in Metallurgical & Materials Engineering and M.E. / M. Tech with Ph.D. Candidates with a Direct Ph.D after B.Tech are also eligible. You must have a first class at both the Bachelor's and the Master's degree level. Make sure you meet these requirements before you go to the walk-in interview. For the full eligibility conditions, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview at the Department of Metallurgical & Materials Engineering, NIT Srinagar. The institute can select or reject any candidate without giving a reason. Canvassing in any form makes a candidate ineligible.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The job is purely temporary. It lasts 11 months, or until the regular faculty joins the department, whichever is earlier. The selected candidate must sign an agreement to serve the institute on the terms and conditions the institute sets. The fixed remuneration of Rs. 65,000/- per month is paid for active duty on this assignment. Selected candidates must join immediately and be physically present at the posting station. NIT Srinagar does not provide accommodation, so selected candidates must arrange their own stay. This engagement gives no right to claim continued employment or a permanent post in future. The institute may defer or cancel the notice at any stage without giving reasons.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Srinagar Temporary Teaching Staff Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check that you meet the essential qualification, including first class at both Bachelor's and Master's level. Fill in your application or bio-data in the prescribed application form. Email the form with scanned, self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and testimonials to [email protected] . Go to the Department of Metallurgical & Materials Engineering, NIT Srinagar, Hazratbal, Srinagar, at 10:00 AM on 9 November 2026. Bring the original documents to the interview. faq.question: Q1. When and where is the NIT Srinagar walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 9 November 2026 at 10:00 AM, at the Department of Metallurgical & Materials Engineering, NIT Srinagar, Hazratbal, Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir.

faq.question: Q2. How much is the salary?
faq.answer: The institute pays a fixed remuneration of Rs. 65,000/- per month for active duty on this assignment.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply with a Direct Ph.D after B.Tech?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says candidates with a Direct Ph.D after B.Tech are eligible for these vacancies.

faq.question: Q4. Is first class compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. You must have a first class at both the Bachelor's and the Master's degree level.

faq.question: Q5. Which email address do I send my application to?
faq.answer: Send your application or bio-data and scanned certificates to [email protected]. Bring the originals to the interview.

faq.question: Q6. How long does the job last?
faq.answer: It is purely temporary: 11 months, or until the regular faculty joins the department, whichever is earlier. It gives no claim to a permanent post.

faq.question: Q7. Does NIT Srinagar provide accommodation?
faq.answer: No. No accommodation is available at NIT Srinagar, so selected candidates must arrange their own stay.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring the originals of your grade cards, degree certificates, experience certificates, category certificates and the other certificates you emailed with your application.

faq.question: Q9. Can the number of posts change?
faq.answer: Yes. The institute may increase or decrease the 02 advertised vacancies if required, and may also defer or cancel the notice.
